हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/RaphNu
show.description: A raw, emotional journey of two souls torn apart by secrets, betrayal, and ambition, only to collide years later with scars, unspoken truths, and a love tested by hidden sacrifices, a fragile child, and financial ruin. As passion reignites, destiny dares to heal what pride and pain once destroyed—but will love survive the cost?”
